hooks.command: G=$(grep -c '^## Guardrail:' "$CLAUDE_PROJECT_DIR"/.loops/guardrails.md 2>/dev/null || echo 0); echo "[loops] .loops/guardrails.md: $G guardrail(s) active. Rules: docs/RULES.md. Start with wiki/index.md and the newest wiki/log.md entries."

cd "$CLAUDE_PROJECT_DIR" 2>/dev/null || exit 0; U=$(git status --short 2>/dev/null | wc -l | tr -d ' '); [ "${U:-0}" -gt 0 ] && echo "[loops] $U unsaved file(s) — when the task is done, /ship"; R=$(git log --oneline --since='2 hours ago' 2>/dev/null | head -1); [ -n "$R" ] && echo "[loops] There was a commit. More than one try, or a correction from Nikita? Skill gm-harness-reflect"; true
